step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify entities in the diagram: ECS (Ingestion), S3 bucket, Kafka cluster, EMR (AGG+ML), ECS (AGG+ML), Couchbase (AGG+ML), ECS (Profile), Couchbase/Elasticsearch (Profile), ECS (Serving), and Couchbase (Serving).
2. Normalize service types against the allowed vocabulary list: ECS -> ECS, S3 -> S3, Kafka -> ThirdParty, EMR -> EMR, Couchbase / ElasticSearch -> CouchBase.
3. Trace the data flow described in the audio and depicted visually:
   - Ingestion ECS receives website event data, cleans it, and writes parallel outputs to S3 (raw historical storage) and Kafka (streaming backbone).
   - Aggregation & ML layer reads events from Kafka and historical files from S3 to calculate real-time dynamic attributes via ECS and batch EMR processing, writing to Couchbase DB and outputting results back into Kafka.
   - Profile layer consumes calculated attributes from Kafka into ECS (Profile), persists merged user profiles into Couchbase/Elasticsearch DB, and writes defined audience memberships back to Kafka.
   - Serving layer consumes audience data from Kafka into ECS (Serving) and indexes it into Couchbase (Serving) for fast customer querying.

graph.name: OnePlus X Data Management Platform Architecture
graph.notes: Architecture for OnePlus X streaming data management platform processing event data to user profiles using ECS, Kafka, EMR, S3, and Couchbase.

nodes.name: ECS (Ingestion)
nodes.notes: Cleans, processes, and prepares incoming website user events for stream and batch storage.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Stores historical event data files used for long-term retention and EMR batch jobs.

nodes.name: Kafka
nodes.notes: Central streaming backbone connecting ingestion, aggregation, profiling, and serving components.

nodes.name: EMR (AGG+ML)
nodes.notes: Dynamically spawned EMR clusters running ML and batch aggregation on S3 data.

nodes.name: ECS (AGG+ML)
nodes.notes: Computes user attributes from event data streams in real time.

nodes.name: Couchbase (AGG+ML)
nodes.notes: Database storing aggregated user attributes and features.

nodes.name: ECS (Profile)
nodes.notes: Combines user attributes from aggregation components to create profiles and audience groups.

nodes.name: Couchbase / Elasticsearch (Profile)
nodes.notes: Storage for combined user profiles and audience criteria representations.

nodes.name: ECS (Serving)
nodes.notes: Handles audience query execution and low-latency API access for end users.

nodes.name: Couchbase (Serving)
nodes.notes: Stores indexed audience membership state for fast querying.
